title: Naturgnosis research Space Node Schema
description: Node model for the Research Space: the world's research artifacts (books, articles, documents, datasets, reports). Categories are restricted to the artifact vocabulary in spec/research/README.md.

tags.description: A set of semantic labels associated with the concept for categorization, navigation, filtering, and search.

layer.description: The primary sociognostic layer in which the element operates.

category.description: The direct conceptual category of the element.

description.description: Short description—concise summary of the concept.

longDescription.description: Long description—detailed explanatory description of the concept.

chronology.description: Historical emergence, evolution, and temporal characteristics of the concept.

relationships.description: Relationship Set—how this node relates to other nodes.

relationshipFamily.description: The family/category of the relationship (e.g., ontological, causal, dependency, classification, interaction).

relationshipType.description: The specific type of relationship (e.g., subtype_of, depends_on, enables, interacts_with, part_of).

description.description: Explanation of why this relationship is relevant.

specific.description: Particular Characterization—category-specific attributes not covered by the generic schema.

metadata.description: Administrative and descriptive metadata such as author, creation date, status, version, provenance, confidence, and maintenance information.

references.description: Sources, literature, theories, frameworks, empirical evidence, and supporting documentation.
